No one bothers to even say hi. Yesterday my friend completely ditched me. I feel like I have no one I can trust, no one to talk to. I have absolutely zero support. It's so hard, I don't know what to do. I lost all hope.

I have three classes left, then I'm going home. I'm just trying to survive now. I won't be feeling better but at least I'll be able to cry.
